name: Query videos
description: Fetches metadata for specific TikTok videos by ID (1-20 per request). Verifies the videos belong to the authenticated user and returns their details, refreshing the cover-image URL's expiration. Unlike List videos, this looks up known video IDs rather than walking recent uploads.

video_ids.title: Video Ids
video_ids.description: List of TikTok video IDs to fetch metadata for (1-20 per request). Only videos that belong to the authenticated user are returned.

Video.title: Video

id.title: Id
id.description: Unique identifier for the TikTok video. Also called 'item_id'.

share_url.title: Share Url
share_url.description: A shareable link for this TikTok video.

like_count.title: Like Count
like_count.description: Number of likes for the video.

view_count.title: View Count
view_count.description: Number of views of the video.

create_time.title: Create Time
create_time.description: UTC Unix epoch (in seconds) of when the TikTok video was posted.

share_count.title: Share Count
share_count.description: Number of shares of the video.

comment_count.title: Comment Count
comment_count.description: Number of comments on the video.

cover_image_url.title: Cover Image Url
cover_image_url.description: CDN link for the video's cover image with a 6-hour TTL.

Video.description: Represents a single TikTok video object.

code.title: Code
code.description: Error code indicating the status of the request (e.g., 'ok' for success).

log_id.title: Log Id
log_id.description: Unique identifier for request tracking and debugging purposes.

message.title: Message
message.description: Error message providing details about the error. Empty string if request was successful.

QueryVideosData.title: QueryVideosData

videos.title: Videos
videos.description: Video objects for the requested IDs that belong to the authenticated user.

QueryVideosData.description: Container for the queried video objects.

QueryVideosResponse.title: QueryVideosResponse

data.title: Data
data.description: Container for the queried video objects. Omitted when the request fails.

error.title: Error
error.description: Standard error response structure containing status information.

QueryVideosResponse.description: Response from TikTok video query endpoint.

error.title: Error
error.description: Error if any occurred during the execution of the action

successful.title: Successful
successful.description: Whether or not the action execution was successful or not
